memories.title: Childhood Home Visit
memories.description: Visiting childhood apartment complex with sister Lori, finding changes in the backyard and encountering the grouchy old apartment manager

memories.title: Relationship with Eliza
memories.description: Interactions with Eliza, including wanting to teach her to fly, feeling left out when she's with others, and being asked to help her with a task
memories.significance: Represents a deep emotional connection and desire for mutual understanding and support

memories.title: Family Dynamics and Conflict
memories.description: Experiences with family members, including a father who is sometimes supportive but also critical, and a mother who is distant or unresponsive
memories.significance: Indicates unresolved family conflicts and a need for clearer communication and emotional support

memories.title: Sense of Responsibility and Guilt
memories.description: Feeling responsible for harming or failing others, such as the woman in the murder scenario or the friend who was supposed to be picked up at the airport
memories.significance: Reflects a strong sense of personal responsibility and a fear of causing harm to others

memories.title: Desire for Freedom and Escape
memories.description: Fantasies of flying, driving recklessly, or escaping from difficult situations, such as the prison or the murderer's clutches
memories.significance: Represents a deep-seated desire for freedom, autonomy, and escape from constraints or dangers
